CustomField.description: Do not use-as we are using this in reports for calculating the duration as per the status changes
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(last_Status_Changed_Time__c), "", IF( (NOW() - last_Status_Changed_Time__c) < 1, TEXT(ROUND((NOW() - last_Status_Changed_Time__c) * 24, 2)) & " hours", TEXT(ROUND((NOW() - last_Status_Changed_Time__c), 2)) & " days" ) )
CustomField.label: Duration
